digest.component_or_area: test suite — attestation and close-guard validation
propositions: Detector and close-guard test suites must be parametrized over both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] tag spellings to explicitly assert regression coverage for the alias.

Plan-time surfaces (p6_ac_quality lint and Pass-3 enrich_operator_attested path) must be covered by added test cases in test_det_floor_operator_attested.py and test_plan_review.py to complete five-surface parity.
The near-miss policy must be decided and pinned for [operator_attested] and both [non_codebase] and [noncodebase] spellings to assert they fail-safe consistently.

Existing test suites test_non_codebase_tag_edge.py and test_non_codebase_close_exempt.py have already proven plan-time lint parity, enrichment parity, and near-miss policy for those surfaces and must not be duplicated.
Guard suites must assert identical outcomes for both tag spellings without weakening existing assertions.
